text_block_list.text:
Worried about Biwa Hayahide not showing up 
for training, I went looking for her...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Trainer-kun! You've arrived at just 
the right moment.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I took part in the salon's "Dramatic 
Makeover☆Hair Volume Reduction 
Campaign"...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As a result, it reduced by a whole 5 
millimeters, successfully lowering air 
resistance! Which means today's training 
will also—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
F-Forgive me... In pursuing short-term 
efficiency, I seem to have... lost sight 
of my true duty...!

She seemed genuinely remorseful, so I told 
her to rest for today... and that we'd 
reset and start fresh tomorrow.
